edges: Griffin cannot bring his request under 5 U.S.C. §§ 702 and 704.
Griffin cannot bring his request under 28 U.S.C. §§ 1491 and 1495.
The forfeiture was part of Griffin's conviction and sentence as per 21 U.S.C. §§ 853(a)(1), (2).
Griffin's request for the return of property was dismissed based on the ruling in United States v. Fitzen.
Griffin's request was dismissed because it did not apply under Fed. R. Crim. P. 41(g).
